nodes.label: PROMPT-52 Registration Console Redesign
nodes.rationale: Presentation-only redesign: the PR #72 status machine is held fixed, and any change to its vitest suite is treated as evidence behaviour moved.

nodes.label: Waitlist as a Queue
nodes.rationale: Waitlist was invisible as a number — organisers counted badges by eye and nobody saw queue position; position = created_at order, exposed only on the token-gated status page.

nodes.label: Withdraw-vs-Refund Action Clarity
nodes.rationale: Refund is money-only (entrant stays confirmed); freeing the spot is Withdraw (which auto-refunds pre-lock) — the two buttons sat side by side with no hint of the split.

nodes.label: Duplicate Entry Hint
nodes.rationale: Duplicates are legal (re-registration after withdrawal, a parent entering two kids), so the marker is non-blocking and scoped to ACTIVE rows in one division.

edges.source_location: Read first — §2 status machine + §4 issue matrix are NORMATIVE
